# Auto Uninstaller [KSU] **A magisk/kernelsu/apatch module to automatically uninstall blacklisted apps.**

## ➤ Features - **Two Powerful Modes:** - **Blocklist Mode:** Automatically uninstalls any app that matches a user-defined blocklist. - **Aggressive Mode:** Automatically uninstalls *any* newly installed app that is not on the whitelist. - **Export/Import:** Backup your blocklist, whitelist, and logs. - **Theme Support:** Switch between Light, Dark, and System default themes. ## ➤ Usage After installation, you can access the module's web interface to configure its settings. 1. Open your KernelSU manager app. 2. Navigate to the "Modules" section and find "Auto-Uninstaller". 3. Tap on the module to open its web UI. ## ➤ License This project is open-source. Feel free to use, modify, and distribute it as you see fit.

Auto Uninstaller [KSU]

A magisk/kernelsu/apatch module to automatically uninstall blacklisted apps.

➤ Features

  • **Two Powerful Modes:**

    • - Blocklist Mode: Automatically uninstalls any app that matches a user-defined blocklist.

    - Aggressive Mode: Automatically uninstalls *any* newly installed app that is not on the whitelist.

  • **Export/Import:** Backup your blocklist, whitelist, and logs.
  • **Theme Support:** Switch between Light, Dark, and System default themes.

    • ➤ Usage

    After installation, you can access the module's web interface to configure its settings.

  • Open your KernelSU manager app.
  • Navigate to the "Modules" section and find "Auto-Uninstaller".
  • Tap on the module to open its web UI.

    • ➤ License

    This project is open-source. Feel free to use, modify, and distribute it as you see fit.
